rows: I can wait for the right moment. I just wish the right moment would hurry up.
Brawling is fun. Then I get bored, and I want the next thing straight away.
Risk! Go on, then. Let us see who blinks first.
Slow? Not on my watch. Okay, fine, a little bit slow. Then it's my turn.
The people have waited long enough for a good match. Let's give it to them now.
I am here, and I am impatient, and both of those are my fault.
I want the highlight. I also want to learn how to do the bit in between. Sorry, I'm rambling.
Stance, ready, go. Ready. Ready. Ready. Okay, go on.
Technique, yes, yes, what next? Right. Show me one, and I will show you one faster.
Strikes are great, I love them. Could we get to them any sooner?
A bet is a rush. I know. I am still going to take it.
A stall? Ugh. Come on. Move. I am bored already.
The people want a contest with a bit of heat. Let's give them some heat.
You say I am overlooked. Overlooked is the word for people who did not turn up. I did.
Proud of your {strength}? Good. Right, next. Sensible. I am proud of mine too. Shall we see whose wins?
I have been waiting to see your {strength}. Right, are you going to show it now or later?
You did not flinch, nice! Sensible. I am not calm. I am going to try, I promise.
Got it, point taken! Okay. Yes. We agree. Can we move on, please?
I could say something quick about that. I will. Then I will stop, I promise.
One pin, go! Keep me down, and I will be annoyed, and then I will shake your hand.
On the mat I will be quick. You will have to stay with me.
Grounded or standing, I am still moving, and I am not sitting down.
Stay in front of me, then, and stop looking at the clock.
Better, finally! Yes, that. Right, next.
You are dodging, come on. Come on, answer. I am waiting.
Got it, point taken! I hear you. Let us get on.
Fine, allowed, go on. See you at the bell, and I mean it this time.
I will give this match everything I have, and I will try to slow down for the important bits.
My approach is keen. You will see it on the night, and I will try to be patient in the middle.
Whatever happens, I want to know what happens next.
The job is still open. I am not done yet, and neither are you.
I have one more thing, and you will see it when the bell goes. Go on, ring it.
Right, you caught me rushing again. No example that proves it. Take that bit out.
I can't back it up, okay? I want to wrestle you, not spend the evening inventing an argument.
Got it. Charge dropped. Next thing, the bell.
Fine, we're past that. Come on, let's get to the wrestling.
Can we find out in the ring? I want to see which of us gets to the next move first.
Come on, the crowd can watch whether I keep that pace when you actually stop me. That's the bit I want.
Enough talk, come on. What can we actually show them when we get moving?
Leave that accusation here. What can the crowd learn from the next thing we do in the ring?
Good, you've planned for my {strength}. Can we get to the bit where you try stopping them now?
You've got an answer to my {strength}, fine. I've already got another thing in mind. Come on, let's go.
Got it. No proof, no verdict. Come on, let's give them something to watch.
Fair, fair. Leave the rumour here; the wrestling is what we can show them.
